candidates.hypothesis: Rapidly brightening transient (Nova or early SN)

history.note: Continued consistent brightening (1.10 mag). Position stable. Alert criteria met.

decision.reasoning: CAND_01 continues its rapid brightening trend, now at magnitude 8.67 with extreme significance (581.6σ). The 25 additional detections in this iteration are clustered within 20 pixels of the primary source and are rejected as PSF artifacts and subtraction residuals caused by the extreme brightness of the primary transient.
